name: Staffordshire Oatcake
desc: Not the crunchy Scottish sort. A soft oatmeal pancake as big as a plate, rolled round cheese and bacon. Restores 60 HP.

name: Lobby
desc: The Potteries' own stew: meat, potatoes, carrots and onions, simmered till you could stand a spoon in it. Restores 80 HP.

name: Oatmeal
desc: Fine Staffordshire oatmeal, the start of every oatcake. Mix with flour, yeast, milk and water, and wait.

name: Kiln Brick
desc: A firebrick from the floor of a Longton bottle oven. It has been heated to over a thousand degrees more times than anyone counted, and it is still faintly warm.

name: Staffordshire Knot
desc: The county badge: a rope tied in three loops, so tight it never comes undone. You'll see it on pub signs, police badges and the county council's crest.
effect_text: Ward up when it first comes out.

name: Hoard Garnet
desc: A replica of a garnet from the Staffordshire Hoard, set over gold foil the Saxon way. Made for a sword hilt, so it knows a thing or two about taking a blow.
